name: Alcolea del Río (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white with the red hoist third, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Alcolea del Río (a castle and a Maltese cross on red above a fish on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Alcolea del Río; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcolea del Río arms — castle and Maltese cross on red above a fish on blue
